column1: # AQL Language Specification: Length-5 Layer — COMPILE (GENERATED)
# format: front-coded
# format: detail-legend
# DO NOT EDIT BY HAND. Regenerate with `make spec-gen` (specgen -extend5 mode).
# Every LENGTH-4 PASSING row, extended by one atom into a 5-part
# combination, then split by outcome. Only length-4 passing rows are
# extended: a length-5 combination whose length-4 prefix already failed
# is captured by a shorter minimal failing prefix in the length-1..4
# files, so this layer is the deduplicated set of genuinely new length-5
# outcomes. Each fail row is itself a length-5 minimal failing prefix.
# Format: FRONT-CODED + legend, extra = detail code. These check clean but
# the compiler will not lower them (detail = the refusal reason).
# detail 0: residual shape beyond Stage 1 (call result above a literal)
# detail 1: operand of unknown provenance or not statically materialisable at dup
# detail 2: operand of unknown provenance or not statically materialisable at drop
# detail 3: operand of unknown provenance or not statically materialisable at not
# detail 4: operand of unknown provenance or not statically materialisable at size
# detail 5: operand of unknown provenance or not statically materialisable at add
# detail 6: operand of unknown provenance or not statically materialisable at sub
# detail 7: operand of unknown provenance or not statically materialisable at mul
# detail 8: operand of unknown provenance or not statically materialisable at eq
# detail 9: operand of unknown provenance or not statically materialisable at and
# detail 10: operand of unknown provenance or not statically materialisable at swap
# detail 11: operand of unknown provenance or not statically materialisable at lt
# detail 12: polymorphic dispatch at dup
# detail 13: polymorphic dispatch at swap
# detail 14: unmatched dispatch recovered at eq
# detail 15: unmatched dispatch recovered at lt
# detail 16: unmatched dispatch recovered at and
# detail 17: unmatched dispatch recovered at swap
# detail 18: forward/stack split depends on a gradual operand (uncompilable)
